scope.description: Closed-form calculations for the independent-audit model in paper/main.tex; not a repeated-game or network-security proof.
assumptions: Honest accuracy is a Normal draw clipped to [0, 1].
Latency is a Normal draw floored at the configured minimum, matching the simulator.
The numerical fabricator distribution is Uniform[0.10, 0.30], below the audit threshold.
Each eligible audit is an independent Bernoulli trial.
U_t = 1; no uptime variation is modeled in the Monte Carlo simulation.
One slash excludes a node only when U_t = 1 and gamma > alpha - tau_excl.

theorem_2_expected_score_gap.interpretation: Positive for the stated low-quality-fabricator audit model only; the one-shot audit rule is not a deployed accuracy oracle.

theorem_3_one_shot_score_input_maximizer.interpretation: For the toy objective, a freely chosen score input has no cost or truthfulness constraint, so the maximum is attained at A=1. This is a direct property of that objective, not an incentive-compatibility result, a claim about true accuracy, or a repeated-game equilibrium.
